{\scriptsize\raggedright
\textit{Population:} BASE paired with FINAL[v]; FINAL[v1] vs FINAL[v2]; SA1 without the BL-01 benchmark cells; X01 without base cells with an auto-closed artifact. \textit{Unit:} base cell.
\textit{CI:} 95\% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full\_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted); 10,000 replicates for the primary-family estimates (R04 composite with strata endpoint+variant, R05 composite with strata comparison+endpoint; Holm-adjusted tests in T9).
SA1 exclude\_dense\_la\_00: repeat Q06/R02/R04/R05 without benchmark dense\_la/00\_dense\_la\_lu\_decomp (BL-01 tolerance disclosure).
SA2 exclude\_auto\_closed: Q10: repeat Q06 without artifacts whose braces the pipeline auto-closed.
SA3 per\_block: every headline estimate per block (pilot, full\_ext) next to the composite.
One row per block, endpoint and hypothesis of the primary family (R04 per variant, R05 per variant pair): the frozen estimate, SA1 (without the BL-01 benchmark cells; its Q06 BASE / FINAL rates are checked on the identical SA1 cohort and given in the estimates) and the post-freeze X01 (without base cells with an auto-closed artifact; X01 and the frozen estimate rest on the same base cells before exclusion, and one X01 cohort serves every variant and comparison of a block and endpoint, checked; 'k excl.' counts the removed cells).
Denominator exclusions (methodology missingness rules; JSON key excluded): a cell marked 'k excl.' excludes k units (X01: base cell(s) removed by the auto-closed rule or outside the endpoint's paired cohort); cells without the mark exclude none; no unit is excluded in this table by R02 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort); R04 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort); Q10 (baseline\_incompatible artifact(s)); R05 (base cell(s) outside the paired cohort).
POST-FREEZE (study\_analysis\_001.addendum\_1, DECLARED\_AFTER\_DRY\_RUN, declared 2026-10-17; descriptive, not part of the frozen methodology): X01 paired\_auto\_closed\_sensitivity - post-freeze and descriptive; the exclusion depends on post-repair artifacts, i.e. it selects on a repair outcome - it shows sensitivity, not a corrected effect; reported next to the frozen R04/R05, never instead of them.
BL01: Includes dense\_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.
IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test\_feedback and combined\_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped\_tests\_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static\_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test\_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.
IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01.
IC5: The composite primary estimates pool the pilot (12 clusters) and full\_ext (48 clusters) blocks; the per-block estimates (T9b) are descriptive, the pilot ones approximate; a composite difference need not hold in both blocks.
IC6: static\_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static\_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.
IC7: The pipeline auto-closes unbalanced braces before measurement; many static\_feedback regressions are base-pass cells whose final repair answer was auto-closed and then failed to build (X01). Q10 (frozen SA2) is unpaired and compares different cohorts.
\textit{Definitions} (methodology and addendum; full text in the JSON form of this table): BASE; FINAL; R02 repair\_success\_rate; R04 net\_gain; R05 variant\_difference; Q10 correctness\_pass\_excluding\_auto\_closed; X01 paired\_auto\_closed\_sensitivity.\par
\textsuperscript{a}~pilot: pilot\_002 / Pilotexperiment (12 benchmarks x 3 execution models x 11 models, 1 sample per prompt); pilot block has 12 clusters: percentile intervals are approximate; flagged in every pilot table\par
\textsuperscript{d}~--: not defined for this row (R02 is a per-variant share and Q10 a per-variant Q06 pass rate; they are shown on the R04 rows, Q10 on the Q06 rows only)\par
\textsuperscript{e}~Q10 (frozen SA2) is unpaired: its BASE and FINAL[v] columns rest on different cohorts (artifacts without auto-closing at each stage), see IC7; the paired sensitivity is X01\par
}
